'''Tay Grutty''' was a [[human]] criminal who lived during the [[Republic Era]] and was a member of the [[Duros]] criminal [[Lazlo]]'s gang.<ref name="The Good Life" /> After Lazlo's death, Grutty continued to serve Lazlo's successor, [[Cad Bane]]. Grutty met [[Vak Lako]] at a spaceport where Grutty went looking for Bane's girlfriend [[Arin]] and found out she married the marshal and Bane’s old friend [[Niro]]. Grutty warned Niro in a bar and left to inform Bane of Arin and Niro. When Bane confronted Niro, Grutty used a [[blaster rifle]] and killed several [[Unidentified police droid model|police droids]] before Niro killed him.<ref name="One Good Deed" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tay Grutty first appeared in the animated miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'',<ref name="The Good Life" /> which episodes were released on [[May 4]], [[2025]],<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}}</ref> were they were voiced by [[Jason Hightower]].<ref name="One Good Deed" />
